cues.en: He's going to say something new and radical in the broadcast. What, that silly grand design? Bernard, that was precisely what you had to avoid. How did this come about? I shall need a very good explanation. Well, he's very keen on it. What's that got to do with it? Things don't happen just because prime ministers are very keen on them. Neville Chamberlain was very keen on peace. He thinks... He thinks it's a boat winner. Ah. That's more serious than that. What makes him think that?
cues.zh: 他打算在广播里发表些激进的新观点。什么，那个愚蠢的宏伟蓝图？Bernard，这正是你本该阻止的。这到底是怎么搞出来的？你必须给我一个非常合理的解释。呃，他对这事特别热衷。这有什么关系？事情可不会仅仅因为首相热衷就发生。内维尔·张伯伦当年对和平也很热衷呢。他觉得……他觉得这能拉来选票。啊。这就更严重了。他凭什么这么觉得？

cues.en: Well, the party who had an opinion poll done, it seems all the voters are in favor of bringing back national service. Well, I have another opinion poll done showing the voters are against bringing back national service. We can't be for it. Of course they can, Bernard. Have you ever been surveyed? Yes. Well, not me, actually. My house. Oh, I see what you're saying. Bernard, you know what happens. Nice young lady comes up to you. Obviously you want to create a good impression. You don't want to look at fool, do you? No. No, so she starts asking you some questions. Mr. Woolley.
cues.zh: 党内做了一次民意调查，似乎所有选民都支持恢复兵役制。那就再做一次民意调查，表明选民反对恢复兵役制。他们不可能既支持又反对。他们当然可以，Bernard。你接受过民调吗？接受过。呃，其实不是我，是我家太太。哦，我懂你的意思了。Bernard，你知道实际是怎么回事。一位迷人的年轻女士走向你。你显然想留下个好印象。你总不想显得像个傻瓜，对吧？不想。对吧，于是她开始问你一些问题。Woolley先生。

cues.en: Are you worried about the number of young people without jobs? Yes. Are you worried about the rise in crime among teenagers? Yes. Do you think there's a lack of discipline in our comprehensive schools? Yes. Do you think young people welcome some authority and leadership in their lives? Yes. Do you think they respond to a challenge? Yes. Would you be in favor of reintroducing national service? Well, I suppose I might. Yes or no? Yes.
cues.zh: 你是否担心失业年轻人的数量？是的。你是否担心青少年犯罪率的上升？是的。你认为我们的公立综合中学是否缺乏纪律？是的。你认为年轻人的生活中是否渴望得到一些权威与引导？是的。你认为他们勇于接受挑战吗？是的。那你是否赞成重新恢复兵役制度？呃，我想也许赞成。请回答是还是否？是。

cues.en: Of course you would, Bernard. After all you've told you, you can't say no to that. So, they don't mention the first five questions and they publish the last one. Is that really what they do? Well, not the reputable ones, no, but there aren't many of those. So alternatively, the young lady can get the opposite result. How? Mr. Woolley, are you worried about the danger of war? Yes. Are you worried about the growth of armaments? Yes.
cues.zh: 你当然会赞成了，Bernard。在说了前面那些之后，你根本没办法说不。于是，他们对前五个问题只字不提，只公布最后一个。他们真是这么干的？呃，有名望的机构不会，但那种机构可没几家。所以反过来，那位年轻女士也能得出截然相反的结果。怎么做？伍利先生，你担心战争的危险吗？担心。你担心军备扩张吗？担心。

cues.en: Do you think there's a danger in giving young people guns and teaching them how to kill? Yes. Do you think it's wrong to force people to take up arms against their will? Yes. Would you oppose the reintroduction of national surveys? Yes. May I have IUC, Bernard? The perfect balance sample. So, we just commissioned our own survey for the Ministry of Defense. See to it, Bernard.
cues.zh: 你认为给年轻人发枪、教他们杀人有危险吗？有。你认为违背意愿强迫人们拿起武器是错的吗？没错。你会反对重新推行国民调查吗？反对。你看吧，Bernard？简直是完美平衡的样本。所以，我们只要给国防部定制一份我们自己的民调就行了。去办吧，Bernard。
